_what: What each legacy results tree actually was. None of this is recorded on the rows; it is declared here, and every entry migrated from it is marked provenance=declared so a reader can tell a stated setup from a recorded one.
_arm_rev: The git revision whose arm sources produced that tree's rows. Hashing the working tree instead would claim the rows came from code that did not exist when they ran -- the three judge arms were edited on 2026-09-19 at 654ac97, after every row in every tree here.
_suite_before: The fixture version for rows that do not carry one. Rows recorded after run_suite gained the field carry it and are believed over this value, which splits a partially re-run tree correctly instead of labelling it uniformly.
_exclude: Files in a tree that are not independent observations. Checked, not assumed: n5_dloop holds 140 rows against dloop's 150, and on the 140 they share NOT ONE outcome differs. It is a subset copy of the same draws, so migrating it would raise N from 5 to 10 on those tasks using duplicated data. Same for n5_m7 against m7. Row-level de-duplication would not have caught this, because the copies differ in incidental fields while the outcomes are identical.

trees.why: The default tree. No LATTICE_THINK was ever set for it, so no think key was sent; qwen has no reasoning channel in any case. decision_first is the only contract that existed before 2026-09-19.

The dark-stage condition: no think key was sent, so the model reasoned by default and consumed the 200-token audit and judge caps before reaching an answer. Its audit and judge stages returned the empty string on every call (50-findings/12 addendum 1). Kept as its own cells rather than merged with results_nemotron_nothink, because an empty judge is a different setup, not a noisier one.
Reasoning off with a 400-token floor, the condition that first made this model's audit and judge stages parse (32-34/34 and 33-34/34 against 0/34).

_fixture_rev: The revision whose FIXTURES produced rows that do not carry the current suite version. Separate from arm_rev: the 0.4.1 fixture repair (f28b453) and the E8 arm edit (654ac97) are different commits, and a row can predate one without predating the other.
_arm_params: Per-arm overrides of the EFFECTIVE params. num_ctx is among them: a cell records what actually ran, and num_ctx was 16384 for the arms queued before the 2026-09-15 cut. An experiment that does not care writes "num_ctx": "any" in its declaration and reuses rows from either side of that cut; one that does care states a value and gets exactly it. The key does not decide which it is -- the experiment does.
